# Data Pipeline Toolkit

A toolkit for building data pipelines with validation, transforms, and monitoring.

The toolkit provides several components and a lot of documentation. The documentation covers installation, pipeline configuration, transforms, error handling, monitoring setup, the plugin API, and a contribution guide. There is also a getting started tutorial that most new users should read first. Team leads who want to standardize pipelines across a group should read the pipeline standards document. If you want to add new transforms, the plugin API document is the right place.

## Installation

```bash
npm install -g data-pipeline-toolkit
```

## Usage

```bash
pipeline run ./pipeline.yaml
```

## Configuration

Edit `pipeline.yaml` to define sources, transforms, and sinks. See the configuration reference for details.
